# qalytools

  
***This package is currently under active development and the code
subject to change.***

*qalytools* provides a simple and intuitive user interface for the
analysis of
[EQ-5D](https://euroqol.org/information-and-support/euroqol-instruments/)
surveys. It builds upon the
[eq5d](https://cran.r-project.org/package=eq5d) package to facilitate
the calculation of QALY metrics, and other related values, across
multiple surveys.

## Installation

The development version of the package can be installed via:

``` r

    repos <- c("https://timtaylor.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos"))
    install.packages("qalytools", repos = repos)
```

## Guidance

Once installed the best way to familiarise yourself with the package is
to view the long form documentation:

- [`vignette("qalytools")`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/articles/qalytools.md)
  provides an introduction to the main functionality of the package.
- The package website also has an ‘EQ5D Analysis’
  [article](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/articles/example_analysis.html)
  that illustrates how to use the package with more context.

# Package index

## EQ5D objects

- [`as_eq5d5l()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/as_eq5d.md)
  [`as_eq5d3l()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/as_eq5d.md)
  [`as_eq5dy3l()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/as_eq5d.md)
  : Coerce to an EQ5D object
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<EQ5D>`*`)`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/coercion.md)
  [`as.data.table(`*`<EQ5D>`*`)`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/coercion.md)
  [`as_tibble(`*`<EQ5D>`*`)`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/coercion.md)
  : Coerce an EQ5D object

## Utility objects

- [`as_utility()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/as_utility.md)
  : Coerce to a utility object

## Metric and summary calculations

- [`available_valuesets()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/available_valuesets.md)
  : Available value sets
- [`calculate_utility()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/calculate_utility.md)
  [`add_utility()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/calculate_utility.md)
  : Calculate utility
- [`calculate_limitation()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/calculate_limitation.md)
  : Calculate limitation
- [`calculate_pchc()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/calculate_pchc.md)
  : Calculate the Paretian Classification of Health Change
- [`calculate_qalys()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/calculate_qalys.md)
  : Calculate quality of life years
- [`summary(`*`<EQ5D>`*`)`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/summary.EQ5D.md)
  : Summary method for eq5d objects

## Datasets

- [`eq5d3l_example`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/eq5d3l_example.md)
  : EQ-5D-3L example data
- [`EQ5D5L_surveys`](https://timtaylor.github.io/qalytools/reference/EQ5D5L_surveys.md)
  : EQ-5D-5L multiple survey example data
